normal_sequence: keep K1 closed and brake energy path supplied
controlled deceleration using confirmed drive limits
confirm bounded residual energy and mechanical support engaged
measure post-contact bus voltage and auxiliary feedback
unexpected_input_loss: ODrive public page gives no quantified input-loss absorption guarantee; it is not a sufficient sole energy sink
emergency_loss_of_torque: No evidence B601 is holding-braked on all axes. Ground test requires independent physical support before any motion release.
legacy_50J_value: requirement only, not a derived arm/target energy bound

equations.resistor: P_inst=V_bus^2/R; E_pulse<=supplier permitted pulse energy; P_average=sum(E)/T; cable and enclosure temperature checked separately

captured_object_regen_source: coupled total inertia/attitude and permitted angular rates required; no use of 24kg legacy model as 705 current mass

coil_driver_screen.reason: Source GX1155V back-EMF plus upstream bus and switch clamp-energy bounds must be reconciled; choosing4A rating alone does not close switching
